turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I send a thank you email after an interview?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, it's a nice touch. Send it within a day, and keep it short and specific.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What do I even write in it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Thank them for their time, mention one thing you enjoyed discussing, and say you're still excited about the role.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if I talked to three people

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: do I email all of them?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ideally, yes, a separate short note to each. Change a line or two so they don't look copied.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What if I don't hear back in a week?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then a polite follow up to the recruiter is totally fine. Just ask if there's any update on the timeline.
